name: efclass-sign-structure
title: Sign structure of an additive gate-function modification to the Friedmann equation
description: Analytical proof and CLASS v3.3.4 numerical verification that the EFC background gate produces ΔE² ≤ 0 under E(0) = 1 normalisation, implying reduced Hubble friction and enhanced growth. Rules out background channel for σ₈ suppression.

methods.modification: 77 lines of C code across background.h, background.c, input.c
methods.verification: Analytical vs numerical comparison at 9 redshift points

results.sign_lemma: ΔE²(z) = A[g(z) − g(0)] ≤ 0 for all z > 0
results.growth_enhancement: +0.5% to +0.76% in fσ₈ at BOSS DR12 redshifts
results.implication: Background-level EFC cannot suppress σ₈; perturbation-level μ < 1 required
